props.name: class
props.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: classes
props.description: Family slot class defaults for this instance.

props.name: items
props.description:
Keys displayed in order as one simultaneous shortcut. Each item is a key string, resolved
like `Kbd` `value`, or an object with `value` and optional `ariaLabel` and `symbol` to
customize one key. The group `size` and `variant` apply to every key. The group renders
nothing when empty.
examples:
import { KbdGroup } from 'moraine'

<KbdGroup items={['meta', { value: 'K', ariaLabel: 'letter K' }]} />

props.name: separator
props.description:
Plain text between keys (not an icon name), or a component rendered between each pair of
keys, for example to show an icon. The component receives the `index` of the key it follows.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: styles
props.description: Family slot style defaults for this instance.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual style variant applied to rendered shortcut keys.

item.description: One key of the shortcut: a key string, or an object that customizes that key.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible label for this keycap. Overrides the spoken name of a key alias.

props.name: symbol
props.description: Whether to resolve a known key alias to its symbol and spoken name, like `Kbd` `symbol`.

props.name: value
props.description: The key to display, resolved like `Kbd` `value`.
